brief_summary: Grouped horizontal bar chart. Five switches (Gateron Magnetic Jade, Cherry MX2A Red, Durock T1, Kailh Box Jade, C3 Equalz Tangerine R2), each with a solid coral bar for actuation force and an outlined bar for bottom-out force on a shared 0-80g axis. Each row is labeled with its gram gap, calling out the Tangerine R2's unusually tight 5g spread and the MX2A Red's wide 30g spread.
